assumptions.statement: The repository provides only rough provisional SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-dependent areas, ratios, figures, PDFs and HTML are provisional and must be regenerated together after trusted official polygons arrive.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: trusted official SITE_BOUNDARY or any official KEY_AREA polygon is added

assumptions.statement: Project-specific FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines, utilities, fire and planning controls are absent.
assumptions.impact: Land-use and built-form content is a conceptual urban-design reference, not an approved regulatory plan or engineering conclusion.

assumptions.statement: Cleared current building footprints, uses, conditions, ownership and parcel boundaries are absent.
assumptions.impact: Six building footprints are reversible test-fit prototypes only; they do not classify existing buildings for retention, renovation or demolition.

assumptions.statement: Exact protected-object boundaries and construction-control zones are not in the site package.
assumptions.impact: Heritage interventions are limited to reversible interpretation around known public heritage references and require authority review.

assumptions.statement: No cleared site hydrology, drainage-capacity, flood-level or catchment model is available.
assumptions.impact: Visible-water and sponge measures are conceptual performance hypotheses; no parcel runoff or flood-protection claim is made.

assumptions.statement: Official station pages list accessibility facilities, but a continuous station-to-park route has not been field-audited for this submission.
assumptions.impact: Arrival carpets and crossings are audit targets and conceptual alignments, not proof of current barriers or approved construction.

assumptions.statement: Accountable agencies, operator, staffing, procurement, budget and maintenance capacity are not committed.
assumptions.impact: RACI, cost bands, phasing and annual events are reference governance options for negotiation, not government commitments.
